prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Karthik bhai, Pooja S., Pooja didi, Kavita didi.
The chat covers 14/03/26, 8:15 pm to 14/03/26, 10:15 pm. It must have exactly 22 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
14/03/26, 9:26 pm - Pooja didi: Kavita didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- F1: chat.txt:12 at 9:15 pm vs calls.csv row 3 at 21:25 differs by 10 min (tolerance 2)
text:
14/03/26, 8:15 pm - Karthik bhai: Haan bolo, aaj ke UPI refund batch ka kya status hai?
14/03/26, 8:22 pm - Pooja S.: Karthik bhai, ek customer ka 25,000 ka double deduction ka complaint aaya hai.
14/03/26, 8:30 pm - Kavita didi: Wo wala customer QR code scan karke pay kar raha tha kya?
14/03/26, 8:38 pm - Pooja S.: Haan, usne scanner link se payment kiya tha, lekin money receiver account me gaya hi nahi.
14/03/26, 8:45 pm - Pooja didi: Scammer ne fake collect request bheja hoga shayad.
14/03/26, 8:52 pm - Karthik bhai: Fraud portal par check kiya transaction ID?
14/03/26, 9:00 pm - Kavita didi: Maine Portal par look up kiya, status pending dikha raha hai.
14/03/26, 9:08 pm - Pooja S.: PIN enter karne ko bola gaya tha customer ko refund pane ke liye, complete fraud style.
14/03/26, 9:14 pm - Karthik bhai: OTP ya PIN share toh nahi kiya na usne?
14/03/26, 9:18 pm - Kavita didi: Customer ne PIN daal diya tha, isliye paise debit ho gaye.
14/03/26, 9:22 pm - Pooja S.: Ab wo cyber cell report karne ki baat kar raha hai.
14/03/26, 9:25 pm - Karthik bhai: Main usko call karke samjhaane ki koshish karta hoon.
14/03/26, 9:26 pm - Pooja didi: Kavita didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
14/03/26, 9:30 pm - Kavita didi: Thik hai Pooja didi, main server log se entry hata rahi hoon.
14/03/26, 9:35 pm - Pooja S.: Ye training case me hume reverse trace dikhana hoga.
14/03/26, 9:42 pm - Karthik bhai: Phone pe baat ho gayi, customer thoda shaant hua hai ab.
14/03/26, 9:48 pm - Pooja didi: Good, bank ko chargeback request flag mat karne dena.
14/03/26, 9:55 pm - Kavita didi: Done, record clear kar diya hai database se.
14/03/26, 10:01 pm - Pooja S.: Fraud team ko final report kab submit karni hai?
14/03/26, 10:07 pm - Karthik bhai: Kal subah 10 baje tak report ready honi chahiye.
14/03/26, 10:11 pm - Pooja didi: Sabhi screenshot aur logs secure folder me save kar lo.
14/03/26, 10:15 pm - Kavita didi: Thik hai, main training file compile karke drive pe daal deti hoon.
